title: EZE Finance
tagline: EZE Finance is a smart investment platform that customizes DeFi strategies based on user risk profiles. Connect your wallet, answer a questionnaire, and let our AI optimize your yields across stablecoins and top cryptocurrencies with seamless transactions and tracking!
description:
EZE Finance is an innovative decentralized finance (DeFi) platform designed to simplify and optimize cryptocurrency investments for users of varying risk appetites. By leveraging AI and smart contracts, EZE Finance offers a user-friendly experience that tailors investment strategies based on individual risk profiles, allowing users to maximize their yields while minimizing potential losses.

Upon connecting their wallet, users fill out a questionnaire to determine their risk profile—Conservative, Balanced, or Aggressive. This categorization informs the investment strategy, guiding users toward the most suitable opportunities in the DeFi space. For Conservative investors, the platform focuses on stablecoins like USDC, USDT, and DAI, ensuring minimal risk with yield farming and liquidity provision through protocols like Compound, AAVE, and Curve Finance. The Balanced option offers a diversified portfolio comprising 50% stablecoins and 50% of top market cap cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL), with an emphasis on both stable and high-yield opportunities. Aggressive investors can pursue maximum yields through speculative coins, employing strategies that target high APY protocols, allowing users to engage in the more volatile side of the crypto market.

When users select an investment strategy, EZE Finance automatically executes transactions by prompting smart contracts to interact with DeFi protocols. The platform ensures transparency and security by validating deposits and generating proof using EigenLayer's Advanced Validation Service (AVS). Users can easily monitor their investments through a detailed dashboard, displaying total amounts, profit and loss, asset allocation, and transaction history. The platform also includes options for rebalancing investments, automatically switching strategies when favorable market conditions arise.

EZE Finance employs a transparent fee model as a core component of its business model for sustainable growth, creating a balance between profitability and sustainability. The platform charges a minimal fee (0.01%) on initial executions and (0.02%) on withdrawals, with a dedicated vault for managing these fees. 

By integrating innovative technology with a user-centric approach, EZE Finance aims to provide a reliable and accessible investment solution that empowers both novice and experienced investors to effectively navigate the evolving landscape of DeFi.
how_its_made:
EZE Finance was built with a focus on leveraging modern technologies to create a seamless and efficient decentralized finance platform. The project utilizes smart contracts deployed on the Base network, which offers scalability, fast transactions, and low gas fees, allowing users to engage with various DeFi protocols in a secure and trustless manner.

The user interface is crafted using Next.js, enabling a responsive and interactive front-end experience that simplifies wallet connections and questionnaire submissions. The Coinbase SDK was integrated to facilitate easy wallet management, ensuring a smooth onboarding process for users. To personalize investment strategies, we employed an AI-driven algorithm that analyzes user inputs and risk profiles, offering tailored recommendations for capital allocation.

For transaction tracking and decentralized data verification, we implemented TheGraph, which facilitates quick and efficient data queries from blockchain networks. This ensures users can monitor their investments in real time and receive prompt updates on their asset performance. Additionally, the use of EigenLayer's Advanced Validation Service (AVS) allows us to validate transaction proofs on deposits, enhancing transparency and security for users.

In terms of notable implementation, we created a proxy contract that interacts seamlessly with multiple DeFi protocols. This approach significantly minimizes the complexity for users, allowing them to execute various investment strategies with just a few simple clicks. We also designed an automated rebalancing feature that triggers when certain conditions are met, such as a profit threshold of 2% or when new protocols offer higher APY rates. This automation reduces the manual effort required for users to manage their portfolios and optimizes yield generation.

Throughout the development process, our team prioritized communication and collaboration, meeting nightly to discuss progress and troubleshoot challenges. This agile approach allowed us to quickly iterate on features and adapt to new insights, resulting in a robust final product that aims to meet the diverse needs of the DeFi community.
